summary: Spec fidelity (checker.md section 5: a notRun command that is not in schema or has no effectNote 'is a fixture error, as for a failing prepare step'; the checker stops and reports no check): at L1 both validations run in invoke_l1 (l1_plan.rs:271 and 345), after invoke_all has already run every notRun command that has an ok entry once (mod.rs:368-374, invoke_served). A fixture that names a write command (for example notRun [init] with commands.init.ok) is FIXTURE_INVALID only after that command ran once in a sandbox copy and was killed. No state outside the sandbox is touched, so the effect is limited to the sandbox. Blast radius: L1 and L2 runs of a mis-written notRun.
